_comment: PINNED EVIDENCE FILE — Bot 2 must use these values as ground truth. v2.0: Added complete source roster from manual search (5 Pool A, 3 Pool B, 6 Pool C). Fixed structural/air_water non-disclosure scoring.

complaints.description: 14-day primer window creates installation constraint — wood must be primed within 14 days of delivery or warranty voided
complaints.note: This is an installation constraint, not a manufacturing defect. Indicates high QC expectations but field sensitivity.

complaints.description: Large casement framing reported as inadequate for bigger window sizes — flex and seal issues on oversized casements
complaints.source: Multiple professional sources including GBA architect and Houzz threads
complaints.note: YELLOW — specific to large casement configuration, does NOT affect double-hung. Multiple independent sources confirm. Design limitation, not manufacturing defect.

sources.name: GBA building science community (Zone 5/6 architect)
sources.summary: Strong endorsements for Zone 5 performance. GBA architect reports 0.03 cfm/ft² airtightness achievement with blower door test success. Actively specifying Loewen for high-performance projects.

sources.name: GBA building science community (triple-pane discussion)
sources.summary: GBA contributor reports U-value 0.15 on triple-pane Loewen configuration. Highly favorable thermal performance data from field installation.

sources.name: Fine Homebuilding installer review (1)
sources.summary: FHB installer reports 'never had a call back' on Loewen installations. Strong endorsement of reliability and build quality.

sources.name: Fine Homebuilding installer review (2)
sources.summary: FHB installer describes Loewen as 'well made' with flanges 'way better' than competitors. Hardware and installation details praised.

sources.name: Fine Homebuilding installer review (3)
sources.summary: Additional FHB professional endorsement of Loewen build quality and field performance.

sources.name: Matt Risinger installation video
sources.summary: Matt Risinger (verified building professional, YouTube) demonstrates Loewen installation. Positive assessment of product quality and design.

sources.name: WESKetch Passive House project
sources.summary: WESKetch architecture firm used Loewen in Passive House project. Reports outperforming Title 24 energy requirements by 50%. Strong professional endorsement in high-performance context.

sources.name: Verified trade professional (Edmonton installer)
sources.summary: Edmonton-based installer on Reddit reports positive long-term experience with Loewen. 'Would buy again.' Canadian market perspective.

sources.name: Consumer community (Houzz threads)
sources.summary: Houzz threads show mixed consumer experiences. Positive on product quality, some complaints about large casement design (confirmed YELLOW above). Service experiences vary.

sources.name: Consumer review platform (Trustpilot)
sources.summary: $500K project with service disaster. This is a service/dealer issue, not a product quality issue. Single extreme case.
sources._note: Service complaint, not product quality. Should not heavily influence product scoring.

sources.name: Consumer media (This Old House / Today's Homeowner)
sources.summary: This Old House: $1,513 avg cost, A+ BBB rating. Today's Homeowner: 51/100 rating — PRICE-BIASED, typical of consumer sites rating premium products against mass-market price expectations.
sources._note: Today's Homeowner score is textbook price-bias per our filter rules. A+ BBB is meaningful. Apply 50% discount on price-biased Pool C source.

professional_consensus._note: v2.0: Complete source roster. 5 Pool A (GBA x2, FHB x3), 3 Pool B (Risinger, WESKetch, Reddit installer), 3 Pool C (Houzz, Trustpilot, consumer media). Strong positive consensus from professionals; mixed-to-negative from price-sensitive consumer sources.

component_quality._note: Coastal Douglas Fir core, AAMA 2605 Kynar 500 PVDF paint system, mortise and tenon joinery, Cardinal Glass with stainless steel spacers, dual weatherstripping.

repairability._note: Cardinal Glass IGUs with 20-year warranty. Dealer network across North America. Transferable warranty.

thermal.note: NFRC certified, Energy Star qualified. Douglas Fir frame with aluminum cladding — inherently low frame conductivity. Triple-pane available. No specific DH U-Factor published. Score above midpoint for material advantage and certifications.

structural.note: LC-PG30 to LC-PG55 by size. Highest for DH is LC-PG55 (e.g., 41.8x64.3 clad/non-clad). Water 8.25 PSF. Florida approvals FL14692, FL15772. Clad LC-PG30-55, non-clad LC-PG25-55.

air_water.note: Manufacturer does not publish air infiltration value for DH configuration. GBA anecdotal report (0.03 cfm/ft² whole-house) suggests excellent air sealing. Energy Star / NFRC certified. Scored at certification floor for wood_clad material class. Actual performance may be significantly better.
